name: NFTG presale unprotected setMainContract
summary: The NFTG presale's setMainContract(address), which sets the token PresaleWithUSDT pays buyers in, had no access control. A fresh contract set it to USDT; in the next transaction the attacker bought eleven times for 76.5 USDT each with a flash loan and was paid about 989.6 USDT per purchase, a token amount priced for NFTG, draining the presale's 10,044 USDT. The main contract was set back to NFTG 202 blocks later.
notes: Anchor: 0xf5ce6f26's call through its contract 0x43fb0c58 setting the main contract to USDT (selector 0x3ded33bc, setMainContract(address)), the setup the drain 0xbd330fd1 by 0x5af00b07 needed; the same EOA restored NFTG in 0x338c9ec8. Neither is the owner 0x76ebdad3; eth_calls of setMainContract from arbitrary addresses succeed at blocks 40000000 and 44348345. The contract is unverified; forked replays show PresaleWithUSDT paying NFTG at block 44348340 and USDT from block 44348360.
Loss: the presale's net USDT outflow in the drain, equal to the attacker's profit; no other PresaleWithUSDT call fell between the two setMainContract calls.
